mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate directly reduces the discount rate for equity valuation, leading to higher S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without any additional conditions.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.1%.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 9.0% for two consecutive months, it signals a deepening economic contraction that triggers a sell-off in equities, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 9.0% for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in both housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates a broad-based weakening in consumer demand, which triggers a negative S&P 500 return over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS does not produce negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of declining industrial production (INDPRO < 95.0), the S&P 500 tends to underperform as manufacturing weakness signals an impending recession, leading to negative 60-day forward returns.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 95.0.

mechanism_narrative: A quarterly GDP growth rate above 2.0% (GDPC1) indicates robust economic expansion, which supports equity valuations and leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of quarters when GDPC1 > 2.0%.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year CPI inflation rate exceeds 3.5% (CPIAUCSL), the Federal Reserve is likely to tighten monetary policy, causing a sell-off in equities and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 3.5% (y/y).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and decline in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals a deteriorating labor market, which triggers negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint increase in UNRATE and decline in PAYEMS does not produce negative 5-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In the context of a housing market slowdown (HOUST < 550.0), the S&P 500 tends to experience negative returns over the next 20 days as housing weakness signals broader economic weakness.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when HOUST < 550.0.
